companyDescription: AI compute monopoly · Blackwell/Vera Rubin GPUs + CUDA lock-in — the toll booth on every hyperscaler capex dollar
priceNote: Live price Aug 13 07:49, +3.03% today. Prior report (Aug 5) used $211.94 — +5.7% drift in 8 days. Now 13.5% above the $195-200 preferred zone with earnings 13 days out.
summary: Consensus across the largest analyst sets is $302.83 (61 analysts, Strong Buy), with wider polls reading $316.79 (67) and $319 (79) — call it +35% from here against a $180 low and $500 high. Q2 FY2027 earnings land Aug 26, with the Vera Rubin shipment ramp behind it as the second leg. The thesis is unchanged and unusually well-supported for a $5.4T company; the issue is that the stock has run 5.7% in eight days into the print and now sits 13.5% above the entry zone. Note the measured reality check: this dashboard's earnings_beat bucket has an 0% hit rate on +30%/14d across 42 completed windows — a mega-cap moving 30% in two weeks is close to physically impossible, so treat the consensus target as a 12-month figure, not a catalyst-window one.

catalysts.name: Fiscal Q2 FY27 Earnings
catalysts.description: Street looks for continued datacenter acceleration. The read-through that matters is Blackwell supply commentary and the first hard Vera Rubin timing guidance. Note: sources conflict between Aug 26 and Aug 27 — Aug 26 is a Wednesday, NVIDIA's usual reporting day, so that is used here.

catalysts.name: Vera Rubin H2 2026 Shipments
catalysts.description: Next-generation platform shipping in H2 gives the FY2028 revenue step. Any pull-forward or slip in this schedule is the single biggest swing factor on out-year estimates.

risks: 13.5% above the preferred entry zone going into a print — the pre-earnings drift is spent
Mega-cap physics: at $5.42T, a +30% move inside the 14-day North Star window has essentially never happened, and this dashboard's earnings_beat bucket confirms it (0/42 completed windows)
Expectations are the risk, not results — NVDA fell 4% on a beat in May 2025, and AVGO managed only +4.7% on a strong Jul 2026 print
Hyperscaler capex concentration: a handful of customers drive the majority of datacenter revenue
Vera Rubin schedule slip would reset FY2028 estimates that are already in the price
Analyst range is $180 to $500 — even the bulls disagree by nearly 3x on terminal value

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.50-3.75%, held Jul 29 for a fifth consecutive meeting with three dissents preferring a hike. Next FOMC Sep 16, three weeks after earnings.
macroRisk.inflationNote: July CPI (Aug 12) headline 3.4% from 3.5%, core 2.5%, +0.1% m/m — a soft print that cut hike odds, following July payrolls at -23k with >100k of downward revisions.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Semis carry the index. With the S&P at record highs and VIX near 14.9, a hawkish surprise hits NVDA harder than the market because it is the crowded expression of the AI trade — that concentration is the macro risk, not NVDA's own rate sensitivity.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — earnings quality is not in question; positioning and index concentration are.
